python3 - <<'EOF'
# Prove the running server's HTTP responses (status lines, headers, sha256
# fragments) by driving its handler in-process over a socketpair — no network.
import importlib.util, io, socket, hashlib, http.client
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("pypi_server", "pypi_server.py")
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

class FakeResp:
    def __init__(self): self.buf = b""
    def write(self, b): self.buf += b
    def flush(self): pass

def request(path):
    a, b = socket.socketpair()
    h = m.Handler.__new__(m.Handler)
    h.rfile = io.BytesIO(f"GET {path} HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\n\r\n".encode())
    h.wfile = FakeResp(); h.client_address = ("127.0.0.1", 0); h.server = None
    h.command, h.path, h.request_version = "GET", path, "HTTP/1.1"
    h.headers = __import__("email.message", fromlist=["Message"]).Message()
    h.handle_one_request()
    return b.recv(65536).decode("latin-1") if False else h.wfile.buf.decode("latin-1")

for p in ["/", "/simple/", "/simple/vectorops/", "/packages/vectorops-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl"]:
    r = request(p)
    head = r.split("\r\n\r\n")[0]
    body = r.split("\r\n\r\n", 1)[1] if "\r\n\r\n" in r else ""
    print(p, "->", head.splitlines()[0])
    assert "no-cache" in head, p
    if p == "/simple/vectorops/":
        real = hashlib.sha256(open("dist/vectorops-0.1.0-py3-none-any.whl","rb").read()).hexdigest()
        assert f"#sha256={real}" in body, "hash mismatch!"
        print("   sha256 fragment matches real file hash:", real)
    if p == "/":
        assert "302" in head and "/simple/" in head
print("all handler checks passed")
EOF
